metadata.description: Doruk's AI coding harness for Claude Code — discuss to find a task's shape, then build directly or hand a multi-step build to orchestrate, backed by a committed .doruk/ state & memory layer and cross-model delegation (Codex, Gemini) in isolated git worktrees.

plugins.name: doruk-ai-harness
plugins.description: 12 skills across five category dirs — workflow (discuss: find the shape before building), state-memory (handoff, feature-roadmap, feature-organize, wrap), delegation (codex, gemini-delegate, orchestrate, worktree-init, worktree-lifecycle), understanding (explain-diff-html, a third-party skill imported verbatim — see PROVENANCE.md), and meta (lean-instructions: rules for writing lean instructions for frontier models). Every leaf is declared in the plugin's skills[] manifest, so /plugin install loads all 12 natively even though they live under category subdirs (skills/<block>/<name>/). skills/legacy/ keeps the superseded pre-Fable pipeline for reference — not in this manifest, not installed. install.sh stays as an offline / non-Claude-Code fallback that flattens every leaf into ~/.claude/skills/.
